question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The allowance which is paid to wife on legal separation
solution:
The correct answer is: **Alimony**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alimony **is a noun that means a regular allowance that a husband or wife pays to their spouse after legal separation or divorce. (निर्वाह निधि)

 
 
• **Example**: *After the divorce, she received alimony to support her financial needs.*
 
 
 
• The word comes from the Latin word "**alimonia**" which means nourishment or sustenance.
 
• Alimony is usually paid by the higher-earning spouse to the other spouse in order to support them financially.
 
• In some cases, alimony may be paid for a limited period of time, while in others it may be paid until the recipient's spouse remarries or dies.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
